changes: New: LOGACID, a generative 303-style acid-line generator, a port of the Phazerville TB_3PO applet through Charles Vestal's Schwung port, tb3po.c. As a track machine on Flex and Static samples (SRC SETUP, like VECTOR) it writes note trigs with PTCH, HOLD, VOL and FILTER DEPTH locks and real slides; as a MIDI generator (MIDI NOTE SETUP) it writes NOTE, VEL and LEN locks.

DENS, ACNT, SLID, ROOT, SCAL and GATE on the SRC page; SEED, VAR, AVEL, AFLT, DIR and MOTF on SRC SETUP. A knob turn redraws the line, YES rolls a new seed, LEVEL push shows the stock sample controls.
Slides on a sample track hold the sample through the next step and glide its pitch there without a retrigger; on a MIDI track they overlap the next note so a 303-type synth slides.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta). Card firmware cannot include it.
Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator; the slide-trig mask, the HOLD units per step and the MIDI LEN table are to be read off the unit.
